name: Lemuel
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy

points: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him. This goes with Titus 2 and 3 about the aged women. Lemuel was a nickname for Solomon, so this is Bathsheba teaching Solomon.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows (Part 2)

points: These are the words of King Lemuel, the prophecy his mother taught him. She warns her son not to give his strength to women nor his ways to that which destroys kings.

note.label: Proverbs 31: The Mother's Charge and the Virtuous Woman
